en.headline: John Lee pledges deeper GBA integration and faster Northern Metropolis after meeting Xi
en.dek: The Chief Executive outlined strategies for cross-border mobility and infrastructure after speaking with the Chinese President at the APEC summit in Shenzhen.
body: Chief Executive John Lee has pledged to deepen Hong Kong’s integration into the Greater Bay Area and accelerate the Northern Metropolis megaproject after attending APEC meetings in Shenzhen.
Lee briefly spoke with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the summit. He told the President that the Greater Bay Area’s potential is enormous.
On Thursday, Lee outlined strategies for deeper integration through infrastructure development, aligning rules and standards, and promoting cross-border mobility and exchanges.
He also secured agreements and held bilateral talks with leaders from seven of the 11 APEC economies, including Malaysia, Vietnam, Brunei, Thailand, Chile, Peru and Singapore.
The meetings took place as China hosts the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting under the theme of building an Asia-Pacific community to prosper together.
Lee is expected to return to Hong Kong on Thursday.

zh.headline: 李家超會晤習近平後承諾深化大灣區融合及加快北部都會區
zh.dek: 行政長官在深圳亞太經合組織峰會後，闡述透過基建、規則銜接及跨境流動推進融合的策略。
body: 行政長官李家超在出席深圳亞太經合組織會議後，承諾深化香港與大灣區的融合，並加快北部都會區大型項目。
李家超在峰會上短暫與國家主席習近平交談。他向習近平表示，大灣區的潛力巨大。
周四，李家超闡述透過基建發展、規則及標準銜接，以及促進跨境流動與交流來深化融合的策略。
他亦與11個亞太經合組織經濟體中的七個達成協議，並舉行雙邊會談，包括馬來西亞、越南、文萊、泰國、智利、秘魯及新加坡。
有關會議在中國主辦亞太經合組織經濟領袖會議期間舉行，主題為共建繁榮的亞太共同體。
李家超預計於周四返回香港。
